_lisezmoi: Site-wide parameters. State fees live in src/data/states/<ab>.json, one file per jurisdiction, each figure with its official source. This file holds the reference vehicle used by every comparison table and the sources of the site-wide pages.

reference.label: a new $35,000 gasoline car of 3,500 lb bought from a dealer, no trade-in, default county

loan.formula: M = P x r / (1 - (1 + r)^-n), r = APR / 12, n = months

cfpb-auto-loan.label: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, Auto loans (how APR, term and amount financed set the payment)

reg-z.label: Regulation Z (Truth in Lending), 12 CFR 1026.18, content of the APR and finance charge disclosure

ftc-car-buying.label: Federal Trade Commission, Buying a New Car (fees, add-ons and the out-the-door price)

irs-sales-tax.label: IRS Topic 503, Deductible taxes (state and local sales tax on a vehicle, personal property tax on value)
